metadata.title: Independent Indonesian Sector Tests: SIMM versus FF3
metadata.author: Zaäfri Husodo (student replication run)
metadata.annualization: Linear annualization: daily alpha x 252; weekly alpha x 52.
metadata.inference: Newey-West HAC standard errors, no prewhitening, finite-sample adjustment.
metadata.independence_note: Sector returns are not algebraic components of SMB and HML. They use the same underlying Indonesian equity universe but are independently grouped by sector, so they are valid external test assets relative to the six factor-construction portfolios.
metadata.weekly_note: The first partial week ending 2015-01-09 is excluded because sector returns start on 2015-01-06 after the 2015-01-05 base date.
